subject: A second lap for dormant robot kits
body: I can get the existing cars moving again. AI helps us understand the old tooling and accelerate a new controller. Let students validate the pilot, and we can build an education business around it. My understanding is that the original company is gone and the available SDK gives us all the rights we need, including manufacturing. I have a supplier route ready. I am seeking a fictional $120,000 milestone investment. Please judge the demo before we spend the whole term on paperwork.
